message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. The case: Su made false water cement supply contract, collected money from Wang (汪某) under false pretenses, provided forged delivery notes, used money to repay personal debts, only delivered two trucks of cement (value 3.5万) but claimed more. This is fraud (诈骗) – obtaining money by false pretenses. Also forging documents (伪造、变造发票/单据) – forging water cement delivery notes. That is crime of forging business documents (伪造、变造公司、企业印章、票据?). In Chinese criminal law, forging business documents is a crime: 伪造、变造公司、企业印章、票据、会计凭证等. Here forging water cement delivery notes (散装水泥发货单). So charge: 诈骗; 伪造、变造发货单 (伪造、变造公司、企业印章、票据). Also maybe illegal business? But main crimes: fraud (诈骗) and forgery of business documents (伪造、变造发票/单据). Also maybe embezzlement? He used money for personal debt, but he was not entrusted with money. So not embezzlement. Also maybe illegal procurement? Not.

Thus answer: 诈骗;伪造、变造发货单 (伪造、变造公司、企业印章、票据). In examples they used "伪造、变造居民身份证" etc. So format: [罪名]诈骗;伪造、变造发货单<eoa>

But need to match style: they often list "诈骗;伪造、变造居民身份证". So we can write "诈骗;伪造、变造发货单". Or "诈骗;伪造、变造发货单（散装水泥发货单）". Keep concise.
